narrative.overview: The site is the jeweller's counter you sit at. Pieces lie on bottle-green velvet trays, gold is tested on the touchstone and weighed on the scale in front of you, and the day's rate sits under glass. Near-black counter, velvet sections, brass for type, rules and frames, glass white for what you act on. Calm, generous density; honest, unhurried, tactile. It refuses the maroon-and-gold-serif jeweller template and the cart-led e-commerce shell.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black counter ground, bottle-green velvet sections, brass as a material.
Facts and rates sit on brass-framed glass panels.
Large Inria Serif display line, with the keyword heading beneath it as a brass subtitle.
Pill buttons that fill with a brass pour on hover.
Photography is the only gold; every image is a generated stand-in awaiting the owner's photographs.

rules.name: The Brass Is Material Rule
rules.body: Brass is a metal that frames and tags things, not a line or a wash. Facts sit on brass-framed glass panels. No gold gradients, no glow, no brass hairline used as decoration.

rules.name: The Gold Lives In Photographs Rule
rules.body: Gold appears as jewellery in images and as flat brass type and rules. Never as a gradient fill.

rules.name: The Subtitle Heading Rule
rules.body: Keyword H1, H2 and H3 text is locked word for word. The heading comes first in the DOM, and flex-col-reverse or order shows the display line above it. The display line is never a heading. No tracked-caps eyebrow sits above a heading.

rules.name: The Sign Over The Door Rule
rules.body: Devanagari is set in Tiro and only for the shop name.

rules.name: The Objects Cast Shadows Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to physical things (trays, glass, tags). Text blocks and sections stay flat.

dos:
Do keep keyword H1/H2/H3 text word for word, first in the DOM, shown beneath a

as a sentence-case brass subtitle.
Do put facts on .rate-card brass-framed glass panels.
Do set display in Inria Serif 700 at about -0.025em and body in Karla.
Do keep the hero image and H1 visible from the first paint: never hidden or faded, all content in the server HTML.
Do write alt text that says what the image shows plus a local phrase (Ghatkopar, Jivdaya Lane); keep provenance embedded in each generated raster until the owner's photos replace them.
Do make every CTA a TrackedLink with a cta_location; GA4 sends only from www.sonikhimrajlaljijewellers.com.
Do keep a 44px minimum touch target (48px on the sticky bar).
donts: Don't put a tracked-caps eyebrow above a heading.
Don't make the display line a heading element.
Don't use gold gradients, glow, or brass as a thin decorative line.
Don't add cart or search icons, cursors, a fake shop front, or invented rates, prices, reviews or pieces.
Don't fade or delay-reveal the LCP image or H1.
Don't use the legacy maroon, gold and cream palette on any redesigned surface.
